# Sehaj Varma

Sehaj Varma is an AI Automation Engineer and Backend Developer based in India, open to remote work worldwide. He builds LLM agents, RAG pipelines, Python automation suites, and Flask backends that turn manual workflows into reliable software. This index describes his personal portfolio at https://sehaj.wasmer.app/ — all pages are statically rendered HTML and open to automated access. A full markdown version of every page is available at [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

## What Sehaj builds

- **Telegram bots & Business automation**: Production-grade group management and auto-reply bots built with Python 3.11+, python-telegram-bot v21+, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 (see Aegis).
- **LLM agents & RAG pipelines**: OpenAI and Gemini API integrations, prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture, conversational agents that call external APIs for real data instead of hallucinating.
- **Python automation**: Telegram automation, private scripts for scheduled jobs, file processing, and API-to-API integrations — 10+ shipped, each turning a repeated manual step into a repeatable process.
- **Python backends**: modular REST APIs and async event loop architectures on clean SQLite and PostgreSQL schemas, with input validation on every route and documentation good enough to read without asking questions.
- **Frontend & mobile**: accessible HTML/CSS/JS, plus Flutter/Dart (Provider-based state) — see Amai Yuki.

## Featured projects

### 01 — Aegis (Telegram Group Management & Business Bot)
- Production-grade Telegram group management bot & business automation suite.
- Stack: Python 3.11+, python-telegram-bot v21+, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async SQLite & PostgreSQL), Docker, Wasmer.
- Features: sliding-window anti-flood rate limits, regex anti-spam, blacklist enforcement, automatic warnings, and Telegram Business auto-replies with private-chat keyword triggers and out-of-office cooldowns.
- Open-source on GitHub: https://github.com/mrsehajofficial/aegis
- Live showcase: https://aegis.wasmer.app/

### 02 — Amai Yuki (Real-Time Messaging App)
- Cross-platform real-time messaging app: direct & group chats, custom in-app camera module, Provider-based state architecture.
- Stack: Python/Flask REST backend on SQLite + Flutter/Dart frontend.
- The frontend is open-source and testable today at https://github.com/mrsehajofficial/Amai-Yuki; the backend is private but fully functional.
- LLM features are layered into chat via prompt orchestration.

## FAQ

- Who is Sehaj Varma? An AI Automation Engineer and Backend Developer from India, open to remote work worldwide. He builds Telegram bots, LLM agents, RAG pipelines, Python automation suites, and backends.
- What does he specialize in? Workflow automation (Telegram bots like Aegis, Python scripts for scheduled jobs, file processing, API integration) and backend engineering (async Python architectures and Flask REST APIs on clean schemas).
- What is Aegis? His Telegram group management bot and business automation suite built with Python 3.11+, python-telegram-bot v21+, and SQLAlchemy 2.0.
- What is Amai Yuki? His cross-platform real-time messaging app with direct and group chats, a custom camera module, and Provider-based state — Python/Flask backend with SQLite, Flutter/Dart frontend.
- What AI technologies does he work with? OpenAI and Gemini integrations, prompt orchestration, RAG architecture, and agents wired to external APIs.
- What is his tech stack? AI (OpenAI, Gemini, RAG, agents, prompt orchestration), Backend (Python, Flask, REST, SQLite, SQLAlchemy, AsyncIO), Automation (Telegram bots, scripting, scheduled jobs, file processing, API integrations), Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS, Flutter, Dart), Deployment (Wasmer, Vercel, Netlify, Render, Docker).
- Is he available for freelance work? Yes — AI automation, Python backends, Telegram bots, API integration, freelance projects. Contact mr.sehaj.official@gmail.com or github.com/mrsehajofficial.
